summary: Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to declare ordinary quarterly cash dividends: $0.03 per common share and $0.52344 per depositary share of its Series A preferred stock. The dividends are payable on June 15, 2026 to holders of record on June 2, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or management change. This is a routine current report regarding a standard dividend declaration, not a special situation.
